snippet.title: Orbital Checkpoint // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3594540/Orbital_Checkpoint

Orbital Checkpoint is a sci-fi border control simulator. Check alien documents, scan suspicious luggage, detect contraband, and manage your tight budget on station GSA-42. Regulations change daily, but bills for oxygen and coffee always arrive on time. Will you risk letting the Acid Lemons pass?

👥 Players: Single-player
🛠️ Developer: VitalGrid Games
📚 Publisher: VitalGrid Games
📅 Release Date: Aug 27, 2026
🎯 Genre: Adventure, Casual, Indie, Simulation

AI Generated Content Disclosure
The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:We developed the game with AI assistance for graphics, coding, and music. All AI assets are pre-rendered and static.
